fields.Name: T375 - Command Palette No Match Empty State
fields.Description: Hits the empty-state branch (mj-empty-state 'No applications found' + the query-present Knowledge Hub action) — a distinct code path from the populated results branch.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Press Ctrl+/ (Windows/Linux) or Cmd+/ (Mac) to open the command palette. Type a nonsense string that matches no application, such as 'zzzqqqxyz'. Verify the palette responds with a clear no-results state — a 'No applications found' empty-state message and/or a fallback action such as 'Search Knowledge Hub' for your typed text — rather than showing stale results or crashing. Seeing the empty/no-match state render cleanly is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The command palette opens and accepts the typed no-match query
A clear no-results/empty state appears (e.g. 'No applications found') and/or a Knowledge/Search fallback action row is offered
The palette does not show unrelated leftover application results for the gibberish query
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
